title: Intermediate Course in Torsion Casting
summary: Carries a Basic student on to qi-packed arms, so the bolt flies far past the plain reach of the engine.

title: Treatise on the Charged Skein
summary: Teaches the care of skeins with qi and how a charged skein throws a bolt harder and lower.

title: Rules of the Rolling Platform
summary: Shows a crew how to move, plant and fire a wheeled ballista, with qi in the legs to carry the load.

title: Elevation and Windage Canon
summary: Instructs a shooter in setting elevation, allowing for wind and ground, and lobbing a bolt over cover.

title: The Crew Chief's Intermediate Book
summary: Teaches a crew chief to command a ballista's posts, pace its fire and rally the crew under strain.

title: Handbook of Bolts Heavy and Light
summary: Covers the shafts and heads a ballista throws and how each is wound, aimed and loosed for its use.

title: A Course in the Shielded Engine
summary: Trains a ballista aimer to fight from behind a mantlet and turn return fire without losing the shot.

title: Measures of Range and Fall
summary: Teaches range reckoning by pace, rod and shadow, and how to bracket a distant mark with successive bolts.
